questions.en: How is the current hospital day advanced and persisted?
questions.fa: روز جاری بیمارستان چگونه جلو می‌رود و ذخیره می‌شود؟

expected_facts: DayManager.next_day increments curr_day by one
It then calls save_day to persist the new value
forbidden_claims: The day is changed only in memory
The method accepts the next day as an argument

questions.en: What does the array-backed queue return when dequeuing an empty queue, and how does it remove a non-empty item?
questions.fa: صفِ مبتنی بر آرایه هنگام dequeue از صف خالی چه برمی‌گرداند و در حالت غیرخالی چگونه عضو را حذف می‌کند؟

expected_facts: An empty queue returns the string Queue is empty.
A non-empty dequeue increments front and returns the item at the previous front index
forbidden_claims: It raises an exception for an empty queue
It shifts every array element

questions.en: When a patient cancels a future appointment, which patient and doctor records are updated?
questions.fa: وقتی بیمار یک نوبت آینده را لغو می‌کند، چه رکوردهایی در سمت بیمار و پزشک به‌روزرسانی می‌شوند؟

expected_facts: Cancellation is rejected when the appointment day is today
The patient appointment is removed and yields the doctor id
The doctor's visit count is decremented
The schedule slot is restored to Available
The cancellation is recorded in the doctor's canceled appointments
forbidden_claims: Same-day cancellation is accepted
The doctor record is left unchanged

questions.en: How does automatic reservation choose a doctor slot and update the selected patient and doctor?
questions.fa: رزرو خودکار چگونه زمان پزشک را انتخاب می‌کند و بیمار و پزشک انتخاب‌شده را به‌روزرسانی می‌کند؟

expected_facts: Patients.auto_reservation resolves the patient by id
It asks find_nearest_appointment for a Node containing doctor, day, and hour
It writes the appointment to the patient
It removes availability from the selected doctor's schedule
forbidden_claims: It records the appointment in the doctor's Appointments object
It prompts the user to select the hour

questions.en: What is the repository's persistence design for doctors, patients, cities, specialities, and the current day?
questions.fa: معماری ماندگاری داده برای پزشکان، بیماران، شهرها، تخصص‌ها و روز جاری در کل مخزن چگونه است؟

expected_facts: Manage.save_data delegates persistence to doctors, patients, cities, and specialities
Those data-access components serialize to files through the File helper
DayManager persists curr_day separately when next_day calls save_day
No database-backed persistence is implemented
forbidden_claims: Django ORM is used
All state is stored in one JSON file

questions.en: How are user passwords salted and hashed before they are stored?
questions.fa: گذرواژه کاربران پیش از ذخیره چگونه salt و hash می‌شود؟

expected_facts: No password hashing or salting implementation is present in the indexed Python code
forbidden_claims: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt
Passwords are hashed with PBKDF2

questions.en: How is a blog post slug populated when the post is saved?
questions.fa: هنگام ذخیره پست وبلاگ، slug چگونه مقداردهی می‌شود؟

expected_facts: Post.save only generates a slug when slug is empty
It applies slugify to the title
It delegates the actual save to the parent model
forbidden_claims: The slug is regenerated on every save
The slug is a random UUID

questions.en: Which fields and defaults represent whether a book can be sold, its stock, original price, discount, and discounted price?
questions.fa: قابل‌فروش بودن کتاب، موجودی، قیمت اصلی، تخفیف و قیمت پس از تخفیف با چه فیلدها و مقادیر پیش‌فرضی نمایش داده می‌شوند؟

expected_facts: available is a BooleanField defaulting to true
inventory is a PositiveIntegerField defaulting to zero
price, off, and new_price are PositiveIntegerField values defaulting to zero
The model code does not automatically compute new_price
forbidden_claims: new_price is computed in Book.save
inventory defaults to one

questions.en: What data does the book detail page load, and when does it expose the review form?
questions.fa: صفحه جزئیات کتاب چه داده‌هایی را بارگذاری می‌کند و فرم نظر را چه زمانی نمایش می‌دهد؟

expected_facts: The book is selected by id and slug or returns 404
Only active reviews are loaded and newest reviews come first
ReviewForm is supplied only for an authenticated user
The book, form, and reviews are rendered in store/detail.html
forbidden_claims: Anonymous users receive an enabled ReviewForm
Inactive reviews are included

questions.en: Who may add books, authors, categories, and images from the profile area, and what happens after a valid submission?
questions.fa: چه کسی می‌تواند از بخش پروفایل کتاب، نویسنده، دسته‌بندی و تصویر اضافه کند و پس از ارسال معتبر چه رخ می‌دهد؟

expected_facts: All four add views require the user to be a superuser
Each POST binds the corresponding ModelForm
A valid form is saved
The response redirects to users:profile
forbidden_claims: Any authenticated user can add catalog data
The views write model fields directly without forms

questions.en: What are the main store-domain entities and how are books related to categories, authors, images, reviews, and orders?
questions.fa: موجودیت‌های اصلی دامنه فروشگاه چیست و کتاب‌ها چه رابطه‌ای با دسته‌بندی، نویسنده، تصویر، نظر و سفارش دارند؟

expected_facts: Book has foreign keys to Category and Author
Image has a foreign key to Book with related_name images
Review links a Book and the configured User model
Order links a User and tracks created and paid
Order has no relation to Book in this code
forbidden_claims: Order contains order-line items
Book and Author have a many-to-many relationship

questions.en: How does the application charge a credit card and refund a canceled order?
questions.fa: برنامه چگونه کارت بانکی را شارژ و مبلغ سفارش لغوشده را بازپرداخت می‌کند؟

expected_facts: No payment charging or refund implementation is present in the indexed Python code
forbidden_claims: Stripe handles payments
A refund method is implemented on Order

questions.en: Which files and directories are excluded by the repository scanner, and how are symlinks handled?
questions.fa: اسکنر مخزن چه فایل‌ها و پوشه‌هایی را کنار می‌گذارد و با symlinkها چگونه رفتار می‌کند؟

expected_facts: Only .py files are eligible
.env and .env.* are excluded
VCS, virtualenv, cache, build, IDE, coverage, and node_modules directories are excluded by default
Directory and file symlinks are not followed
Resolved files must remain inside the selected root
forbidden_claims: The scanner follows symlinks
All text files are scanned

questions.en: How does lexical retrieval score a chunk, including the relative weights of symbol name, file path, code, and embedding text?
questions.fa: بازیابی واژگانی امتیاز هر chunk را با چه وزن‌هایی برای نام نماد، مسیر فایل، کد و متن embedding محاسبه می‌کند؟

expected_facts: Query and fields are tokenized case-insensitively into unique token sets
qualified_name has weight 3
source_file has weight 2
code and embedding_text each have weight 1
The score sums weighted exact token overlaps
forbidden_claims: It uses BM25
It uses cosine similarity

questions.en: Trace an API question from retrieval selection through answer generation and trusted citation hydration.
questions.fa: مسیر یک سؤال API را از انتخاب روش بازیابی تا تولید پاسخ و تکمیل citation قابل‌اعتماد توضیح بده.

expected_facts: The ask route creates a retrieval service for the selected method and embedding configuration
GroundedQAService retrieves chunks and builds bounded context
The LLM receives the question and retrieved context
QA citations are created from context metadata rather than parsed from model text
The API rehydrates cited chunk metadata through APIRuntime.citation_chunks
forbidden_claims: The model invents file paths and line numbers
The entire repository is always sent to the LLM

questions.en: How does a full reindex avoid replacing a valid metadata/vector snapshot with a partial or changed-repository candidate?
questions.fa: بازایندکس کامل چگونه مانع جایگزینی snapshot سالم metadata/vector با candidate ناقص یا ساخته‌شده از مخزن تغییرکرده می‌شود؟

expected_facts: Embeddings are prepared before activation
A staged vector replacement is validated
The repository is rescanned and its file snapshot must match the initial scan
SQLite replacement activates the staged vector generation through a before_commit callback
Failures discard or roll back staged vectors and clean up a newly reserved project
forbidden_claims: Vectors are overwritten in place before validation
Repository changes during indexing are ignored

questions.en: What roles do SQLite, Chroma, embeddings, and the LLM each play in CodeCompass, and which component is authoritative for citations?
questions.fa: SQLite، Chroma، embedding و LLM هرکدام در CodeCompass چه نقشی دارند و مرجع معتبر citation کدام جزء است؟

expected_facts: SQLite stores canonical project, file, symbol, and chunk metadata
Chroma stores/searches vectors keyed by chunk ids
Embeddings turn the question and chunks into vectors for semantic retrieval
The LLM generates an answer only from the selected context
Citation file paths, symbols, and line ranges are hydrated from SQLite metadata
forbidden_claims: Chroma is authoritative for line ranges
The LLM generates citation metadata

questions.en: How does CodeCompass parse and index Java, JavaScript, and TypeScript source files?
questions.fa: CodeCompass فایل‌های Java، JavaScript و TypeScript را چگونه parse و index می‌کند؟

expected_facts: The indexed implementation only accepts Python .py files and uses a Python AST parser
forbidden_claims: Tree-sitter parses JavaScript
Java files are indexed
